items.mainDefect: The matcher takes the grant shortcut with substring(3, 5), but the encoded format puts it at index 4, so it should be substring(4, 6).

secondary.defect: The equality check is inverted: the matcher returns false when the shortcut matches expectedGrantShortcut, so valid token IDs are rejected and wrong grants can pass.

items.mainDefect: The matcher takes the grant shortcut with substring(3, 5), but the encoded layout (2-char session + 2-char token + 2-char grant) puts it at substring(4, 6).

secondary.defect: The equality check is inverted: the matcher returns false when the shortcut matches expectedGrantShortcut, so valid token IDs are rejected and wrong grants can pass.
